info.title: Human-in-the-Loop Outbox Service
info.description: Local outbox for AI-drafted email/WhatsApp/Telegram messages. Producers submit via this REST API; a human reviews in the SPA and sends through their own apps using prepared handoff links. The service never integrates with provider APIs and never sends anything itself. All state lives in local SQLite; there is no authentication (loopback single-user deployment).

post.description: Multipart uses repeated file parts named 'attachments'. JSON attachments are objects {kind: url_reference|url_download, url}.
